decisions.reason: Changing the selected streamed how-to video URL does not alter the Android app size optimization requirement.
The selected how-to video URL is independent of Android full-app language coverage and localization.
Changing the how-to video URL does not change Android right-to-left layout support.
The how-to video URL selection has no effect on iOS signing certificates or signing readiness.
Changing a streamed YouTube video URL does not alter the iOS app size optimization requirement.
The selected how-to video URL is independent of iOS full-app language coverage and localization.
